SELECT activity.activity_date AS `date`, SUM(activity.post_count) AS postCount, SUM(activity.comment_count) AS commentCount FROM ( SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(p.created_at, '+00:00', '+09:00')) AS activity_date, COUNT(*) AS post_count, 0 AS comment_count FROM post p INNER JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id WHERE
AND p.created_at >= #{startUtc} AND p.created_at < #{endUtc} GROUP BY activity_date
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(c.created_at, '+00:00', '+09:00')) AS activity_date, 0 AS post_count, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comment c INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id INNER JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id WHERE
AND c.created_at >= #{startUtc} AND c.created_at < #{endUtc} GROUP BY activity_date ) activity GROUP BY activity.activity_date ORDER BY activity.activity_date

SELECT b.id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, b.slug AS boardSlug, COALESCE(posts.post_count, 0) AS postCount, COALESCE(comments.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount FROM board b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.board_id, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM post p WHERE p.created_at >= #{startUtc} AND p.created_at < #{endUtc} GROUP BY p.board_id ) posts ON posts.board_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.board_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comment c INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.created_at >= #{startUtc} AND c.created_at < #{endUtc} GROUP BY p.board_id ) comments ON comments.board_id = b.id WHERE b.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED') ORDER BY b.sort_order, b.id
